prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval grounded RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Coarse square pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, restrained 3-tone stone timber wool iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painted surfaces or photorealism. No people, no text or labels, no quest UI, no magic, no outcome animation. Daylight. Room/prop geometry is a proposal, not certified collision, official geography, inventory or narrative outcome. Open ordinary return path remains visually distinct. One compact soot-dark brick and timber charcoal-counting shed, on SAFE exterior side of a low fireproof stone partition. Exactly THREE small separated finite charcoal bins on the shed floor, each with a blank small tally tablet. Beyond the partition, three ordinary brick furnace mouths visible: ONE cold dark mouth with no glow and two distant dull warm mouths, none accessible from visitor path. A plain shift tally board hangs nearby with short notches, no names. Wide dry exterior lane outside shed; no need to pass a furnace to leave. No material magically replenished, no production numbers or sale.
